context_requirements: Proliferating cells with intact CDK/cyclin machinery
Functional p53/RB pathways for robust p21 induction and G1/G2 arrest
Active DNA replication or mitosis for maximal transcriptional response
falsifiers: No decrease in proliferation-associated genes (e.g., CCNA2, CCNB1, CDK1, MCM3) at 6 or 24 h
No induction of CDKN1A or other p53 targets at 6 or 24 h
No difference in response between proliferating and non-proliferating lines
Predominant upregulation of cell-cycle genes rather than downregulation

evidence.supports: p21(CDKN1A) is a key cell cycle inhibitor induced in the DNA damage response, mediating G1/G2 arrest
p21Cip1/WAF1 is induced during terminal differentiation and inhibits CDK2 activity
p27Kip1 is a cell cycle inhibitor regulating G1/S progression
p27 is an independent prognostic marker in breast cancer, linking cell cycle inhibition to clinical outcome
